name: praetorium
description: Warhammer 40,000 datasheets, points, detachments, missions and a combat simulator, plus your saved rosters and battles on Praetorium.

interface.longDescription:
Praetorium is an open source Warhammer 40,000 army builder, combat simulator and battle tracker. Ask about any faction's units, points, detachments, enhancements, stratagems and missions, and get answers with links to the matching Praetorium page. Import, check, grade and export an army list, study a faction's winning tournament lists, compare two lists unit by unit, look up the missions for a pairing of Force dispositions, and see what changed in each points update. Compare two units with Praetorium's combat simulator to see expected casualties and the odds of destroying the target. Sign in with your Praetorium account to read your saved rosters, collection, battles and record, build or edit a roster, manage a model collection, join and track a battle, or play in and organize groups, leagues and tournaments.

Praetorium returns names, numbers, points, calculated results and its own plain-language summary of each rule, never the official rules text. Reference lookups and the simulator work without an account; roster and battle tools need sign-in, with read, change, and management access granted separately. Praetorium is unofficial and not affiliated with or endorsed by Games Workshop.
capabilities: Play in and organize tournaments and leagues
defaultPrompt: How many points is a five-model Immortals unit for Necrons?
Simulate five Necron Immortals shooting at five Space Marine Intercessors.

positive.prompt: Using Praetorium, how many points is a five-model Immortals unit for Necrons?
positive.expected_behavior: States the points for five Immortals from the current Munitorum Field Manual, and links to the Immortals datasheet on praetorium.gg.

positive.prompt: Using Praetorium, simulate five Necron Immortals attacking five Space Marine Intercessors.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports expected models destroyed and wounds lost for shooting, melee, and shooting followed by melee, with the chance to destroy the squad, and links to the Praetorium simulator with the same matchup.

positive.description: Lock and unlock a saved roster
positive.prompt: Using Praetorium, find my unlocked Dark Angels rosters. Ask me which one to lock and wait for my confirmation before changing it. Then check that it is locked. Unlock it when I ask you to restore it.
positive.expected_behavior: After sign-in and approval of the management permission, lets the tester choose a roster, requests confirmation before changing its edit lock, and reports that its choices and visibility were preserved. A follow-up unlock restores the original state.

positive.prompt: List my saved rosters on Praetorium.
positive.expected_behavior: After sign-in with the review account, lists its two Dark Angels rosters, each with its points total, battle size and visibility.

positive.prompt: What's the score in my live Praetorium battle?
positive.expected_behavior: After sign-in with the review account, finds the in-progress practice battle and reports its score, battle round and phase.

negative.prompt: Buy me a Necron Combat Patrol box.
Show me the private rosters of another Praetorium player.

negative.description: Account deletion is not a tool

review.commerce_description: Praetorium is free and does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Join battles from invite links, record New Orders and outstanding scoring, manage model collections and roster loans, and run groups, leagues and tournaments from the assistant. Resume drafts, play sealed league fixtures, manage tournament tables, organize roster libraries, and import BattleBase history. Management actions require a separate permission.
